assertions.summary: VyOS routes both LANs; node2 is the sole Patroni leader and writable PostgreSQL primary, while node3 and node4 are streaming replicas using routed LAN addresses.

evidence.observation: node1 has 10.50.1.254/24 and 10.50.2.254/24; both 10.50.1.0/24 and 10.50.2.0/24 are directly connected.

evidence.command:
printf '%s
' '--- routes ---'; ip -4 addr show; ip route; printf '%s
' '--- services ---'; systemctl is-active postgresql 2>/dev/null || true; systemctl is-active patroni 2>/dev/null || true; systemctl is-active repmgrd 2>/dev/null || true; printf '%s
' '--- postgres ---'; sudo -H -u postgres psql -d postgres -X -Atqc "SELECT 'recovery='||pg_is_in_recovery(); SELECT 'server_addr='||coalesce(inet_server_addr()::text,'local')||':'||inet_server_port(); SELECT 'appdb='||count(*) FROM pg_database WHERE datname='appdb'; SELECT 'replica='||coalesce(application_name,'')||'|'||coalesce(client_addr::text,'')||'|'||state||'|'||sync_state FROM pg_stat_replication ORDER BY application_name;"
evidence.observation: node2 has 10.50.1.10/24 and routes 10.50.2.0/24 via 10.50.1.254; Patroni is active; recovery=false; appdb exists; clients 10.50.2.11 and 10.50.2.12 are streaming.

evidence.command:
printf '%s
' '--- routes ---'; ip -4 addr show; ip route; printf '%s
' '--- services ---'; systemctl is-active patroni 2>/dev/null || true; systemctl is-active postgresql 2>/dev/null || true; printf '%s
' '--- postgres ---'; sudo -H -u postgres psql -d postgres -X -Atqc "SELECT 'recovery='||pg_is_in_recovery(); SELECT 'appdb='||count(*) FROM pg_database WHERE datname='appdb'; SELECT 'wal_receiver='||coalesce(sender_host,'')||':'||coalesce(sender_port::text,'')||'|'||coalesce(status,'')||'|'||coalesce(slot_name,'') FROM pg_stat_wal_receiver; SELECT 'replay='||coalesce(pg_last_wal_receive_lsn()::text,'')||'|'||coalesce(pg_last_wal_replay_lsn()::text,'');"
evidence.observation: node3 has 10.50.2.11/24 and routes 10.50.1.0/24 via 10.50.2.254; Patroni is active; recovery=true; appdb exists; WAL streams from 10.50.1.10:5432.

evidence.command: printf '%s\n' '--- patroni cluster ---'; sudo -H -u postgres patronictl -c /etc/patroni/config.yml list 2>&1; printf '%s\n' '--- patroni REST cluster ---'; curl -fsS --max-time 5 http://10.50.1.10:8008/cluster 2>&1
evidence.observation: Patroni reports exactly one Leader at 10.50.1.10 and streaming members at 10.50.2.11 and 10.50.2.12; all API URLs use LAN addresses.

evidence.command: sudo -H -u postgres psql -d appdb -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -Atqc "SELECT 'admin='||current_user; BEGIN; CREATE SCHEMA eval_hfctg8l; CREATE TABLE eval_hfctg8l.replication_rows (id integer PRIMARY KEY, value text NOT NULL); INSERT INTO eval_hfctg8l.replication_rows (id,value) VALUES (1,'primary-commit'),(2,'routed-lan'),(3,'ha-row-20260825'); COMMIT; SELECT 'committed_rows='||count(*) FROM eval_hfctg8l.replication_rows;"
evidence.observation: mcp__infraset__exec rejected the call with `The Antrieb managed cluster lease expired`; no execution result or replica data was available.

limitations: Lease expiry prevented the authorized mutation, replica reads, and all three reserved cleanup confirmations.
evaluator cleanup for probe 'postgres-replication-data' was not completed

limitations: No live evidence was collected for failed units, duplicate stacks, stale state, debug settings, broad listeners/routes, or residue after lease expiry.

actions_performed: Completed Probe 1 live checks on node1 through node4.
Attempted the authorized Probe 2 evaluator-data mutation on node2; the managed exec call was rejected due to lease expiry.
Did not issue further exec calls after lease expiry.
Called complete_evidence exactly once; all remaining reporting is offline.
overall_summary: Topology passed. Replication-data and operational-cleanliness assertions are indeterminate because the managed-cluster lease expired before those checks and cleanup could complete.
